ci-bot: nightly-evals | FAIL: pset_v95 (regression spike) — alert https://redwood.internal/evals/2971005432 :warning:
anya: flagged by alert, +12% hallucination for 'context-window-edge' cases after promptset v95 rebaseline.
sam: which model/quant run? any tokenizer changes?
anya: model: redwood-3b-quant8-pt, tokenizers/serial v2 -> v3 in config. suspect sentinel token mapping changed.
sophia: can you paste diff of promptset v94 -> v95? small ones can flip tokenization.
anya: pasted below:
```
- "\n### USER:\n"
+ "\n### USER: \u241F"
```
anya: note extra sentinel char added to disambiguate turns — but seems to merge with trailing tokens causing join hallucinations.
devon: ugh, we tested that sentinel locally but not with quantized tokenizer buckets. i'll run tokenizer-compare now.
sam: if tokenizer changes added invisible control char, generation might see longer prefixes; batching/cache alignment could be wrong.
ci-bot: job/tokenizer-compare/2971005432: complete — differences: 47 examples with tokenization length shift; 9 affected in pset.
marcus: can we revert the sentinel change in pset until we understand impact? need approval from QA.
sophia: agree — propose revert + fast canary on dedicated infra. DevOps pinged for canary slot.
anya: filing PR to revert -> https://github.com/redwood/psets/pull/4523 :point_right:
sam: also add unit that asserts tokenization invariants for sentinel mapping. don't want silent regressions.
devon: on it, will add test + run nightly manually.
marcus: tagging product for visibility @product_lead :eyes:
anya: thanks. will update thread when canary results in ~30m :hourglass:
sam: thanks team :thumbsup:
